text: The Patriots head to Miami on Sunday for Week 8 looking to bounce back after Drake Maye and company fell to the Bears 30-24 on Thursday night, a loss that underscored one of Mike Vrabel's central concerns: the team's turnover differential has become a serious problem. The good news is that the secondary should be at full strength for the matchup against the Dolphins, according to Mike Reiss's analysis, giving New England's defense a fighting chance in South Florida. Rob Gronkowski's induction into the Patriots Hall of Fame will take place the following Saturday, November 7th at 1 PM at Patriot Place Plaza, providing a bright spot amid the team's recent struggles. The game kicks off at 4:15 PM ET on Sunday, November 1st, and if you're looking to make some picks in survivor pools, ESPN's strategists are actually recommending the Patriots as one of your top options for the week.
